name: Numbers
summary: Three numbers sections for the AhaSlides marketing sites (Webflow Numbers), in the layouts of the Untitled UI metrics sections the marketing team picked: simple centred (with dividers or left aligned), simple with icons, and a split with an image slot, on White, Accent or (the split) Vivid Pink. Each layout has one button. Framework-free HTML and CSS bound to the shared --aha-* tokens, built from values the Hero, Statistic card, Hero banner and Button contract already ship.
highlights: Three layouts on one page, each with its own labelled preview and paste-and-run snippet, and one button each, placed after the numbers

Simple centred carries switches instead of near-copies: Number style (Divided or Left aligned), Icon and Description; the old Simple with actions 01 (actions-row) is this layout with Left aligned, Icon Off and Description On, and its old link still lands here

Backgrounds: White (the default) and Accent, the pale pink bgAccent surface laid over white by adding aha-numbers--accent to the section; the icon squares turn white so they stay visible. Split image 02 adds Vivid Pink (aha-numbers--brand), which replaces the separate brand layout, and its old link still lands here
Layout copied from Untitled UI; every colour, size, space and radius is an --aha-* token. The title and lead carry the Hero section's values and the buttons are <aha-button size="xl">
A number looks the same here as in the Statistic card on the Cards page: same font, size, weight and colour, with the same title and text beneath
The picture is the DS image placeholder, 4:3, edge to edge in its slot with rounded corners and no frame or card around it; swap it for a real image
Icons are registry glyphs called by name with <aha-icon>
Each section is a container-query block: it steps down at 991 px and 767 px and tightens again below 480 px, wherever it sits
layoutsIntro: Each section copies the layout of one Untitled UI metrics section, and nothing else of it. Class names carry the layout, not the Untitled UI number.

layouts.name: Simple centred
layouts.summary: A centred title and lead, a row of numbers and one centred button. Three switches cover what used to be two layouts (Simple with actions 01, `actions-row`, is this layout with Number style Left aligned, Icon Off and Description On): Number style (Divided centres each number and splits them with thin dividers; Left aligned left aligns them with no dividers), Icon (the icon above the title) and Description (a line of text under each number title).

guidance.title: Choosing a background
guidance.intro: Every layout below has a White / Accent switch in its preview and a tab for each in its code; Split image 02 adds Vivid Pink.

points.title: White is the default
points.text: Use White unless the section needs to stand apart from the white sections around it. It is today's look and needs no extra class.

points.title: Accent
points.text: Add aha-numbers--accent to the section. It lays the pale pink Accent background (bgAccent) over white, so it looks the same wherever it sits. The icon squares switch to white so they stay visible.

points.title: Vivid Pink
points.text: Split image 02 only: add aha-numbers--brand to the section. It is the Hero banner's solid pink with white text, and the button turns secondary with surface="brand" so it stays visible.

points.title: Neighbours
points.text: Never place an Accent section next to another coloured section. Put it between white sections.
